title: Why Did UFO Reports To The Pentagon Triple?
hook: UFO reports to the Pentagon nearly tripled, filed by the government's own people.
closing: Mostly drones. Occasionally weather balloons. Rarely aliens.
question: Ever seen one? Tell me below.

segments.say: A Pentagon office logged 757 new UFO reports last year -- nearly triple what it logged the year before.
Over half of those new reports -- 392 of them -- came from one place: the government's own air traffic controllers.
Out of every report filed so far, only 21 were flagged as something officials genuinely can't explain.
